facts.story_link: sequel · L1 purge numbers against the deck's measurements
facts.statement: Of the three L1 purge counts, 6,570 'orphan contacts' equals the deck's live count of contacts with no company association on 2026-10-01 (C111: 6,570 of 26,293, 25.0%); 2,043 'companies with neither deals nor contacts' and 10,574 'contacts-only auto-creations' were measured neither by the live probe (which counted 12,574 companies without a deal, C112) nor by Hs-Logic (9,150 orphan companies in a capped 10,000 scan, C053). The three counts sum to 19,187, which is 45.7% of the 41,944 records measured on 2026-10-01 (13,679 companies + 26,293 contacts + 1,972 deals), not the '~33% of total CRM records' the row states; the 33% is not recomputable from any admissible source.

gaps: No owner, no priority on any row; Foundation and L1 have no end date, so the 13-Oct start is the only date for ten tasks.

The '~33% of total CRM records' figure cannot be reproduced from the deck's measurements (the three counts sum to 45.7% of the 41,944 records of 2026-10-01); it may use a different denominator or a different definition of 'record'.
2,043 companies with neither deals nor contacts and 10,574 contacts-only auto-creations are not measured by any admissible source; they are the plan's own counts.
Connex is a new entity name with no footprint in the admissible sources.
'Quarto-BQ (HS-Standalone connector)' is not in any repository; the tie to Hs-Logic and Bq-dbt is by name only.
The SEALSQ-only baselines for L3 (companies not orphaned, contacts with phone/LinkedIn) were not measured; the ledger holds portal-wide or capped figures only.
